fields.Name: W7 -> S6.2
fields.Description: Gate G2.33 (phase 2, dataset W7, criterion S6.2): on W7-small-imbalanced s42-s44 every number the trainer reports (holdout primary and secondary scores, every baseline, every candidate's inner score and every paired comparison) carries a finite lower and upper bound on either side of its estimate, 3 of 3 seeds. This is the sidecar half of the gate: the trainer result's numbers; the stored metric rows are covered when the engine's stored rows are measured. It fails when a paired comparison's interval collapses its lower bound onto its estimate (fewer than 3 of 3 seeds with both bounds).

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Every reported score and paired comparison on W7 s42-s44 carries both bounds around its estimate (3 of 3 pytest cases pass).
